instruction: Configure Visual Studio Code to use spaces instead of tabs by enabling the 'Insert Spaces' setting.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling 'Insert Spaces' in VSCode editor settings. This is verified by checking if 'editor.insertSpaces': true exists in settings.json. Uses existing check_json_settings metric function which handles boolean values correctly.
metadata.similarity_to_original: Very similar - same pattern of configuring VSCode editor settings via settings.json, just different setting (editor.insertSpaces vs editor.wordWrapColumn)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches VSCode settings.json from the correct VM path (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric correctly checks for the exact setting required by the instruction (editor.insertSpaces: true)
Expected value is semantically correct - 'editor.insertSpaces: true' is the exact VSCode setting that enables spaces instead of tabs
Complete coverage - evaluator checks the only requirement in the instruction
State accessibility is correct - VSCode settings persist to settings.json file, no postconfig needed
Data flow is correct - get_vm_file returns file path, check_json_settings loads and verifies the JSON content
When expected.type='rule', framework calls get_rule which returns config['rules'] dict, and metric correctly accesses expected['expected']

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
